script.text: After his capture by Sector Security at Kaiba Dome, Yusei was sent to court for sentencing.
Yusei was marked with tracking dye on his left cheek and put on a bus bound for a prison known as The Facility.
Yusei was placed into a cell with another inmate named Tenzen Yanagi, and the two immediately became friends.
Ahhhh! Great to be back! You’re so much nicer than my last roommate.
What’s a guy like you doing here?
Me? It's because I collect cards.
Everyone does that.
But mine are illegal magic relics from ancient civilizations!
That sounds pretty cool. Wish I could see some.
Ta-daa! I’ve been stuck here so many times that I’ve learned how to sneak in my entire deck past the guards! And it’s a good thing I did!
Why? We're not allowed to duel in this prison.
You got a lot to learn, sonny! Dueling is the only way to stay safe! And you’ll learn that lesson soon enough!
But as long as we got these cards, we’re set!
In The Facility, it was illegal to carry decks and duel. However, that didn't stop the prisoners from sneaking their decks in and dueling for respect.
Yusei and Tenzen were quickly confronted by an ex-dueling champion named Bolt Tanner.
Much to the amusement of the other inmates, Yusei borrowed Tenzen's "Treasure Deck" in order to accept Tanner's challenge.
Say hello to my Duel Stadium, newbie.
Now lemme tell ya how things work around here. First day in, everyone duels. You duel good, you get respect.
But don’t get no ideas because I’m the best.
Prove it, Tanner.
Duel you? Against that worthless Treasure Deck? Oh please. I want a challenge.
And you'll get one. You said we duel here for respect. I think it's time you learn what that really means.
